notes: Original soundtrack for every region (harbor, wetlands, Starfall, Frostline, Voltspire, Sandreach, the Rift) plus a battle theme — generated live, with waves, wind, birds and crickets; a quieter version at night. Settings → Music to turn it off

49 new props (Quaternius CC0 kits, re-coloured to Pokebox's toon style): traders stand behind market stalls, smiths at anvils, woodcutters at chopping logs, gardeners among crates, fishers by barrels and rope
Camps now have a pot on the fire, supplies and a bench; ruins have broken pottery and old flagstones; lookouts are Ranger outposts with banners, a training dummy and a weapon rack
The grass is trampled where people work and camp, so everything on the ground is readable
